name: @tank/terraform
description: Operate production Terraform with 2026 field knowledge from core/provider releases, maintainer issues, provider internals, and brownfield reports. Covers state failure modes, query/list bulk import, generated-code traps, ephemeral and write-only data, upgrades, refactoring, tests, and reviewed delivery. Triggers: terraform, terraform plan, terraform apply, terraform import, import block, terraform query, list resource, tfstate, provider schema, moved block, terraform test.
